# `git_log`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] git_log`

Show commit logs. Runs 'git log --oneline' in the working directory.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `author` | string | no | Filter by author name or email |
| `count` | integer | no | Number of commits to show (default: 10) |
| `path` | string | no | Limit to commits touching a specific file or directory |
| `since` | string | no | Show commits more recent than a date (e.g. '2024-01-01', '1 week ago') |
